name: 3D Scan & Show: Product Viewer
author: scantheworld

sections.description:
Show your products and spaces in 3D. No code needed.

Turn regular videos or photos into interactive 3D models that people can spin, zoom, and explore on your website.

What Visitors Can Do

  • Spin products around – See every angle, not just staged photos
  • Zoom into details – Check textures, finishes, fine print
  • Walk through spaces – Virtual tours of properties, stores, venues
  • Click info points – Tap annotations to reveal details, images, links

What You Can Do

  • Upload phone videos/photos – Our AI turns them into 3D models
  • Pick from your library – Connect your Scan the World account, choose models from your dashboard to display
  • Add to any page – Click, select your model, done
  • Annotate key features – Drop markers anywhere on the model
  • Create video tours – Export for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts

Zero coding. Just point, click, publish.

Who Uses This?

  • Online Stores – Jewelry, furniture, collectibles, anything where details matter
  • Real Estate Agents – Property walkthroughs without scheduling showings
  • Tourism Sites – Preview hotels, attractions, venues
  • Museums – Display artifacts people can examine closely
  • Interior Designers – Show off completed projects

How It Actually Works

  1. Log into your Scan the World account (sign up free if you don’t have one)
  2. Upload photos/videos of whatever you want to show in 3D
  3. Our platform creates the model (usually takes a few minutes)
  4. On WordPress, add a block and select which model to display
  5. It appears on your page

That’s it. No embed codes to copy-paste. No iframes to wrestle with. Just browse your models and insert them.

Why People Love This

Regular product photos hide flaws and don’t show scale. People guess. Then they return stuff.

3D models? They see exactly what they’re getting. They rotate it. Zoom in. Check detail.

Result: Fewer “this isn’t what I expected” returns and more confident buyers!

Technical Stuff (Don’t Worry About It)

Works on phones, tablets, desktops. Loads fast. Looks smooth. Integrates with Shopify too if you sell there.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Scan the World account?

Yes, you need to create a free account on the Scan the World platform to use this plugin. The plugin helps you connect your WordPress store to your Scan the World account.

Do I need special equipment to create 3D models?

No! You can create 3D models using just your smartphone. Simply record a video walking around your product, and our AI will process it into a 3D model.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is designed to work seamlessly with WooCommerce. It adds 3D viewing capabilities to your WooCommerce product pages.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The 3D models are hosted on our platform and loaded efficiently through an iframe, minimizing impact on your site’s performance.

Can I use this with any WordPress theme?

Yes! The plugin uses WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg) blocks, which work with any modern WordPress theme that supports the block editor.

What happens to my data?

Product information and 3D model associations are stored in your WordPress database. The 3D models themselves are processed and hosted on the Scan the World platform. See our privacy policy for details.

Is there a free tier?

The plugin itself is free. The Scan the World platform offers various pricing tiers. Please visit our website for current pricing information.
